violation_type.title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served (26 TAC §744.401(6))
violation_type.short_title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served
violation_type.typical_finding: Menu was not posted during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: Menu was not posted during the inspection.
The operation did not have a daily menu on file or posted for review at the operation.
The menu for May/2025 and for the previsou  months were  not available.
There was no menu available documenting the snacks served to the children each afternoon.
The most recent snack menu posting was from November 2023. There are no more recent menus available for review at the time of the inspection.
Daily snack menu wasn't available for review during today's inspection.
